reviews.review_description:
You have to try this game out, its so trippy yet relaxing that I can't recommend it enough. Plus its FREE?? 

Ever since I first played the OG Squingle I fell in love. Now that the sequel is out I cant wait to sink some hours into it.

If you see me in the leaderboards I dare you to challenge me! >:)

developer_response.body:
This absolutely made our day; thank you so much! 💙

It means a lot to hear that you enjoyed the original Squingle and are having fun with Squingle Arcade. We put a lot of love into keeping that signature trippy, relaxing vibe while adding a fresh arcade twist.

And now you've officially thrown down the gauntlet... 👀 We'll be keeping an eye on those leaderboards!

Thanks again for playing and for sharing the love. Welcome back to the flow! 🌀

reviews.review_title: This game is quite the vibe!
reviews.review_description:
I can only say amazing things about this game: it's free, the levels feel challenging yet fun, and the visuals and sound effects are top-notch. 

Such an amazing time-waster. Time flew as I tried to beat the best scores on some levels.

It's one of those games you really have to try yourself to experience it,  and you won't regret it!

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the amazing review! 💙

"This game is quite the vibe" is exactly what we were hoping players would feel. We're glad you're enjoying the balance of challenge, visuals, audio, and the chase for those leaderboard scores.

Hearing that time flew by while you were playing is one of the biggest compliments we could ask for. Thank you!

reviews.review_title: Nice game to move around in!
reviews.review_description:
I enjoy the game with different obstacles to move around in to make it different and unpredictability challenging!

My favorite part about the game is to speedrun because its fun to move around quickly and paced correctly on the spot.

I hope this game reaches a wider audience in a few weeks and people will love it.

Best puzzling,
themash45

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much, themash45! 💙

We're really happy to hear you're enjoying the variety of obstacles and the fast-paced movement. It's awesome that you've been speedrunning the levels; that's exactly the kind of mastery and replayability we hoped players would discover.

We truly appreciate your kind words and support. Hopefully we'll be seeing your name on the leaderboards for a long time to come! 🌀

reviews.review_description: Yes, my theoretical equation that I wrote in this review, says Miss Pac Man and the character from the labyrinth that David Bowie played had a kid and that kid Grew up and took lsd and tried to play a game of Pac man like his mom. This is what he would see

developer_response.body:
😂 We have to admit... this might be one of the most creative descriptions of Squingle Arcade we've ever read!

We're not sure we could've come up with a better comparison ourselves. Thanks for the laugh and for taking the time to leave such a memorable review.

reviews.review_description: What a beautiful game! It works great in mixed reality with hand tracking. Well done!

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much! 💙

We're thrilled you're enjoying the mixed reality experience and hand tracking. We wanted Squingle Arcade to feel as immersive and seamless as possible, so it's wonderful to hear it's working well for you.

Really appreciate you taking the time to leave a review, and we hope you continue enjoying the journey. 🌀

reviews.review_description: highly recommend it, its such an interesting game!

developer_response.body: Thank you for the kind words and the review! :)
